findings.observation: The long weathered adult face, light skin, deep-set eyes, heavy level brow, crooked healed nose, balanced closed mouth, freckles, and composed gaze remain unmistakably Quinon.
His medium-height language, soft rounded middle, gentle shoulder and limb mass, and non-muscular construction remain faithful to the summon through the chibi simplification.
The rolled-sleeve forearms, visible wrists, relaxed empty hands, finger scale, and source-relative girth are preserved without generic fist, glove, or upper-arm inflation.
Blonde-gold braided locs retain their swept-back crown, layered front roots, long side and rear fall, and deliberately tousled but clean construction.

The broad folded work-shirt collar, teal asymmetrical vest, teal-brown apron blocks, waist ties, reinforced brown trousers, teal gaiter panels, and sturdy boots closely preserve the summon with no new accessory or tattoo.
The visible head-and-hair unit occupies only about 30–31 percent of standing height, approximately 3.2–3.3 heads tall, missing the required 32–36 percent / 2.75–3.1 proportion lock.
Exactly one full figure is present, with all locs, head, both empty hands, both boots, and grounding shadow completely inside generous margins.
The planted stance, lowered open hands, apron color blocks, long loc silhouette, and large facial read form a clear weaponless ready-idle at combat-icon scale.
The figure remains grounded in practical weathered workwear with no weapon, attack, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, floating, frame, star, UI, or text.
